_comment: FALLBACK ONLY. Used when the kernel does not answer RequestSystemInfo.
The 2026-08-21 session got no answer at all and the profile was written as
profile-unknown.json, which cannot be diffed against another firmware --
see Docs/FINDINGS.md #17 and Docs/LEDGER.md I2. The app now allows 250 ms
and retries at each run open, so this should not be needed; it is here so
that a second silent kernel still produces a named, diffable profile.
This value is DECLARED, not read. The manifest records
firmware_read_from_kernel: false and the report says so, because putting
somebody's memory into the field every comparison keys on would be worse
than having no key at all.
Everything else is left at its documented default -- see
SensorLab/settings.example.json for what those are and why.
